scenarios.name: exclude-sender-trigger
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes the required trigger with socket_id and await, but only catches a generic error instead of Pusher.RequestError, while Response B provides no trigger at all.

scenarios.name: presence-channel-subscription
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies the rubric with correct client setup and event bindings, while Response A uses Echo abstractions and wrong auth endpoint, missing required events.

scenarios.name: verify-pusher-webhook
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies all rubric requirements, while Response A does not use the required pusher.webhook helper, uses a different raw body type, and implements custom HMAC logic instead of the specified verification method.
